label: Almighty at one being: can do every task that involves no contradiction
definition: IsAlmighty σ P g: for every task t of the Power vocabulary P that involves no contradiction (P.Consistent t), g can do t (P.CanDo g t). The body of GodIsOmnipotent (ST I q.25 a.3) at one being. Counterexample: any agent that cannot do some consistent task.
note: Reuses the Power vocabulary (DEF-ACTIVE-POWER-TASK-VOCABULARY) unchanged; what counts as a task and as consistent is fixed only there. Analyst reading of Dei Filius ch. 1's 'omnipotens', attribution deferred.
